STORY.TITLE: Built on Expertise, Driven by Results
STORY.P1: Elite Conseils & Services Professionnels TI inc (Elite CSP) was founded with a singular mission: to help organizations unlock the full potential of their enterprise assets through world-class IBM Maximo implementations and EAM consulting.
STORY.P2: Headquartered in Québec, QC, our bilingual team of certified IBM Maximo consultants brings deep technical expertise and a client-first approach to every engagement. We have supported organizations across Canada and internationally in transforming their asset management operations.
